book.name: Testament of Naphtali — 4Q215 Hebrew and English Fragments
book.title: Testament of Naphtali — Dead Sea Scrolls Witness 4Q215
book.translator: Covenant Library independent working English rendering from the Qumran-Digital Hebrew transcription (2026)
book.textualTradition: Dead Sea Scrolls manuscript 4Q215, frg. 1–3, 11 surviving lines
book.sourceNote: Qumran-Digital transcription version 2025-03-11 (4Q215 frg. 1–3, lines 1–11); Covenant Library working English translation of that transcription. Hebrew sourceText is retained verbatim for each line, with uncertain readings and lacunae; English is deliberately not reconstructed from modern versions. This is not a continuous complete Testament of Naphtali, and it does not include 4Q215a. The final line does not securely preserve 'she bore me' in the cited transcription.

book.attribution: DFG-Projekt 465277421 'Qumran-Digital: Text und Lexikon' (© 2022); based on former Qumran-Wörterbuch project and a precursor text by Martin Abegg; transcription version 2025-03-11. Changes: resegmented as Covenant Library reader passages by line number; textual readings not deliberately altered. Changes: added a separately credited, tentative Covenant Library English translation line-by-line while retaining Hebrew sourceText and all transcription damage markers.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 1
1.text: […] with Ahiyot [?], the father of Bilhah my [mother] […] Deborah, who nursed Reb[ekah …].
1.sourceText: עם אחיות אבי בלהה א[מי ]תה דבורה אשר הניקה את רב֯[קה --]
1.translationNote: The word אחיות may be a proper name, Ahiyot, or a plural noun ('sisters'); the relationship around Deborah is damaged. The translation does not reconstruct a definite family tree.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 2
1.text: And he went into captivity; Laban sent and redeemed him, and gave him Hannah, one of his maidservants […].
1.sourceText: וילך בשבי וישלח לבן ויפרקה֯ו ויתן לו את חנה אחת מאמהותי[ו --]
1.translationNote: The antecedent of 'he' is in the missing context. Hannah is spelled חנה in this transcription.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 3
1.text: First, Zilpah; and he gave her the name Zilpah after the name of the city to which he had been taken captive […].
1.sourceText: ראישונה את זלפה ויתן את שמה זלפה בשם העיר אשר נשבה אל֯[יה --]
1.translationNote: The phrase 'the first' continues a broken sentence; 'daughter' has not been supplied as surviving text.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 4
1.text: And she conceived and bore Bilhah, my mother; and Hannah called her name Bilhah, because when she was born […].
1.sourceText: ותהר ותלד את בלהה אמי ותקרא חנה את שמה בלהה כי כאשר נולדה[ --]

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 5
1.text: She hurried to suck; and [Hannah] said, ‘How my daughter hurries!’ And she again called [her] Bilhah […].
1.sourceText: מתבהלת לינוק ותואמר מה מתבהלת היאה בתי ותקרא עוד בלהה[ --]
1.translationNote: The repeated name Bilhah is linked by wordplay to the Hebrew for hurrying.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 6
1.translationNote: The line contains no securely recoverable words.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 7
1.text: And when Jacob my father came to Laban, fleeing from Esau his brother, and when […].
1.sourceText: ו֯כאשר בא יעקוב אבי אל לבן בורח מלפני עישיו אחיהו וכ֯א֯ש֯ר֯ ○[ --]

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 8
1.text: […] the father of Bilhah my mother; and Laban led Hannah, my mother's mother, and her two daughters […].
1.sourceText: א֯בי בלהה אמי וינהג לבן את חנה אם אמי ואת שתי בנותיה֯[ --]

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 9
1.text: […] and one for Rachel; and when Rachel had not borne children […].
1.sourceText: []ו֯אחת לרחל וכאשר היתה רח֯ל לוא ילדה בנים ○○[ --]
1.translationNote: The preceding recipient, often supplied as Leah in published renderings, is not legible in this line and is not inserted here.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 10
1.text: […] [Jaco]b my father, and Bilhah my mother was given to him; and she bore Dan my bro[ther …].
1.sourceText: [-- יעקו]ב֯ אבי ונתון לו את בלהה אמי ותלד את דן אח֯[י --]
1.translationNote: The giver is not identified in the preserved portion; the passive English avoids assigning a subject.

1.label: frg. 1–3, line 11
1.text: [… the remaining letters cannot be translated securely …]
1.translationNote: The Qumran-Digital transcription does not securely preserve 'she bore me'; it is not reconstructed or copied from another translation.
